content: Real-world ora2pg migrations (e.g. DEEP case study, 1400+ functions/procedures) follow: estimate scope -> syntax conversion via ora2pg -> dry-run migration -> fix non-compiling functions -> automated unit tests -> fix behavioral/performance issues -> non-regression + performance test pass before cutover. The hard part is verifying business logic parity (transaction boundaries, exception handling, date math, dynamic SQL, package-level state), not just getting code to compile.
